title: Analysis of the texture of human prostate tissue to derive a realistic tissue model for transurethral laser enucleation and morcellation
summary:
As part of the BMBF project OptiPROM, including, a tissue model for human prostate tissue is being created in order to further develop a morcellator.  In order to create a tissue model that is as realistic as possible, the mechanical properties of human prostate tissue are to be determined and compared with a tissue model.
The prostate tissue is taken as part of a routine bladder removal procedure, during which the prostate is also removed. A mechanical procedure, a texture analysis, is used to determine the physical and mechanical properties of the prostate tissue. 
A tissue model is created or revised based on the results of the mechanical analysis.
